description: This file provides a Go package 'dbus' that facilitates interaction with the systemd D-Bus API, including connection management, path escaping/unescaping, and property retrieval.

classes.name: Conn
classes.description: Represents a connection to systemd's D-Bus interface, managing system and signal connections, and handling subscriptions and signals.

methods.name: needsEscape
methods.description: Checks whether a byte in a potential dbus ObjectPath needs to be escaped.

methods.name: PathBusEscape
methods.description: Sanitizes a string for use as a dbus ObjectPath by escaping special characters.

methods.name: pathBusUnescape
methods.description: Reverses the PathBusEscape process, unescaping special characters in a dbus ObjectPath.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Creates a new systemd dbus connection with default context.

methods.name: NewWithContext
methods.description: Establishes a connection to any available bus with provided context.

methods.name: NewSystemConnection
methods.description: Creates a system bus connection with default context.

methods.name: NewSystemConnectionContext
methods.description: Establishes a system bus connection with provided context.

methods.name: NewUserConnection
methods.description: Creates a session bus connection with default context.

methods.name: NewUserConnectionContext
methods.description: Establishes a session bus connection with provided context.

methods.name: NewSystemdConnection
methods.description: Creates a direct connection to systemd without a dbus daemon, with default context.

methods.name: NewSystemdConnectionContext
methods.description: Establishes a direct connection to systemd with provided context.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the established systemd dbus connection.

methods.name: Connected
methods.description: Checks if the connection is active.

methods.name: GetManagerProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a property value from the systemd manager interface.
